rows.text: Created a recurring schedule named "Halcyon Threshold — daily triage" (0 8 * * *) that starts new sessions of the agent.
rows.quote: Set up a daily 08:00 triage session that reads the inbox, updates `DECISIONS.md`, drafts replies, and pings you only for 48-hour items. It is bound by the same rules — cannot pay, send, post, or publish. Delete it any time.
